description: Writes down a prediction BEFORE the fact, with a probability, in the local ledger ~/.suunto-mcp/predictions.json (SUUNTO_PREDICTIONS_PATH overrides it); never contacts Suunto. Immutable: it can only be voided (void_prediction, before its `date`). score_predictions scores it later; get_prediction_stats says whether the probabilities were any good. `date`: strictly AFTER today, at most 60 days ahead. `kind`: session_done (a workout exists on `date`); hrv_in_band (the night after `date` has an HRV within the user's p25..p75 band, get_baselines); recovery_morning_at_least (plus `threshold`: waking recovery after the night after `date`); reps_hit (plus `exercise`, `sets`, `reps`, optional `kg`: at least that many sets reached that many reps at that weight or more; scored from log_session entries, so 'unresolvable' until sets are logged). `probability` is the caller's honest judgement. An identical open prediction is refused with its id. Scored from the second day after `date`. Unknown or kind-foreign fields are refused. At most 2000. Not idempotent. Demo mode keeps the ledger in memory.

date.description: The local day it is about, YYYY-MM-DD: after today, at most 60 days ahead.

exercise.description: reps_hit: exercise name as in get_exercise_history.

kg.description: reps_hit: weight in kg (that or more). Omit for any weight.

rule.description: The rule or skill behind it, e.g. 'weekly-plan'.

sets.description: reps_hit: sets predicted to reach the reps.

threshold.description: recovery_morning_at_least: Balance on waking, 0 to 1 (0.6 = 60% Resources).

name: log_prediction
title: Log a prediction before the fact (local ledger, immutable)
